Package midtermlabproject2

Class TablePrinter

java.lang.Object
midtermlabproject2.TablePrinter
public final class TablePrinter extends Object
Utility class that prints a trace table in the console using +---+ style borders. Column widths adjust to the longest cell.

This class cannot be instantiated.
